source_evidence: Day328~11:05 exact player 'Ask him what he would do if he had access to our properties' delegates this specific question, not actual access, agreement, fee, purchase, transfer of rights, cargo movement or unlawful activity. Mara willingly provides meaningful Help by explaining genuine river-property interests (mill/private berth, bargeyard and fort interests) without claiming a shipping monopoly, operational capacity, special Crown authority or promising access. Predeclared Deception+10 with advantage, DC17 candid ambitions and DC22 concrete proposal involving existing arrangements. Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt batch df6f01769352fd2608a8a25060ff584a, d20 faces3,15, take15+10=25; both thresholds met, no limited feature used. Harthvale willingly explains a prospective business arrangement in keeping with fixed chair role and known finite freight operations: 'I would start with your berth and bargeyard. Space we could reserve when it is available, a regular place to unload and store goods, and a reliable carrier farther upriver. My customers pay for certainty.' He distinguishes a private commercial arrangement from V granting control over public navigation or Crown security, says he would negotiate handling and storage charges and start with a trial consignment, not require V to turn over holdings. He voluntarily acknowledges his own involvement in the existing paid information arrangement: 'We already pay Tavosk through the broker for advance inspection information. I approve that expense for the association. Some of our imported consignments are landed without the duties being assessed.' Broker remains present and does not independently confess or deny. This establishes Harthvale's newly played firsthand statement of his own approval of payments and awareness of undeclared imports, consistent with fixed association chair/broker roles, not proof of exact historical payment authorization for each transaction, murder involvement, violence, new category of prohibited goods or other customer's knowledge. He asks whether V would consider a nonbinding proposal for a trial using available private facilities, subject to actual capacity and agreement; no price quoted, written terms issued, concession of public rights, access granted, deal, payment, shipment or specific cargo established. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar hear his statements; no report yet to Desen. V controls reply. No resource/custody changes beyond dialogue time.
